faith.note: Walk the land of your God-sized dream. Stop praying small, safe prayers — God's capacity is infinite. Identify one unreasonable prayer and commit to it daily.
faith.source: Sermon — The Power of Team and God-Sized Dreams (May 17)

marriage.note: Peace in my home — authority over the chaos. Boldness to hold the line and have heavenly eyes for Lizzie and the kids.
